title: HarvestDef
description:
A harvest definition from JSON type `"harvest"`.

Defines what drops (items, mutagens, etc.) result from harvesting a corpse or dissecting a creature. Used for butchery and dissection results.

entries.description: List of harvest entries describing possible drops.

group.description: Group ID for drop distribution (alternative to inline entries).

source_required_body_part.description: Body part required to be available for this harvest (e.g. "head", "torso").

HarvestEntry.description: A single entry in a harvest definition describing what drops and under what conditions.

base_num.description: Base number of drops (can be [min, max] range or fractional ratio).

drop.description: Item or group ID to drop.

mass_ratio.description: Proportion of the target's mass that this drop represents (0.0 to 1.0).

max.description: Maximum number of this drop that can be obtained.

scale_num.description: Scale number of drops based on size/mass (can be [min, max] range or fractional ratio).
